The LLD Interview Framework (8 Steps, Timed)

One repeatable script for any LLD prompt: clarify, entities, class diagram, APIs, patterns, code, extensibility, concurrency - with minute budgets for a 45-60 minute round, the 15 + 90 + 15 machine-coding variant, and one problem worked end to end with runnable Java and Python.

sections.title: The story: the pilot's checklist
sections.before: First pass: read Levels 1-2 only and look at the pictures. Come back after OOP Foundations and UML, when Step 3 (class diagram) and Step 5 (patterns at change points) will make sense. Java syntax you have not met yet (record, lambdas such as b -> b.id(), synchronized) is decoded in Reading Java as a C programmer.
